rows.title: Broken Embraces 2009, directed by Pedro Almodóvar | Film review
rows.dek_lead: While some of Almodóvar’s films are out-and-out heartbreakers – perfect storms of melodrama, storytelling and extreme living – this is a more cerebral, self-reflective and noir-ish affair.
